claim: Khakhar et al. build PAC prediction sets for code generation, evaluated on PICARD (SQL) and Codex, enabling partial programs with holes in uncertain parts with theoretical guarantees.
stance_target: L1/L3: set-valued uncertainty guarantees for code are prior art; not execution-routed confidence
quoted_support: We evaluate our approach on PICARD (a T5 model for SQL semantic parsing) and Codex (a GPT model for over a dozen programming languages, including Python), demonstrating that our approach generates compact PAC prediction sets.
